# 10. decision: hall of debate (computer-controlled: Muslim after 1575)
oe_ind.10 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_ind.10.title
	desc = oe_ind.10.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_ind_mughal_ibadat_khana.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_ind.10.a
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = religion
				OR = {
					religion = religion:sunni
					religion = religion:shia
				}
			}
			set_religious_school = religious_school:oe_ind_sulh_i_kul_school
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu2_jesuit_asia_mission }
			add_prestige = 5
		}
		add_prestige = 5
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_ind.10.b
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		add_stability = 1
	}
}
